cohort: The cohort consisted of 3,183 deliveries at Gulu Regional Referral Hospital in Northern Uganda between June 2019 and July 2020.
finding: The overall caesarean section rate was 13.4%, with most cases originating from Robson Ten Groups 3 (multiparous, previous CS) and 1 (nulliparous, singleton, cephalic, term, spontaneous labour).
mod_finding: The overall caesarean section rate was 13.4%, but the rates within low-risk Robson groups (1 and 3) were considered alarmingly high.
cross-section timing: Data was collected retrospectively for deliveries occurring between June 2019 and July 2020.
